build_DeepLabCE_standard: build a DeepLabCE loss module with default cross entropy for semantic segmentation training
build_DeepLabCE_hard_mining: build a DeepLabCE loss module with top 20 percent hard pixel mining for segmentation
build_DeepLabCE_class_weighted: build a DeepLabCE loss module with per-class weight tensor for imbalanced segmentation
review_DeepLabCE_forward: review the DeepLabCE forward method to understand per-pixel loss weighting and top-k pixel selection
test_DeepLabCE_ignore_label: test the DeepLabCE loss module with a custom ignore label for masked regions
